facts.text: The hotel is directly adjacent to the BTS Asok Skytrain station and steps from the MRT Sukhumvit subway station.
facts.excerpt: The Westin Grande Sukhumvit is directly adjacent to the BTS Asok skytrain station and just steps from the MRT subway station at Sukhumvit.

facts.text: Terminal 21 Asok, with local designers and international labels, is nearby.
facts.excerpt: Shop at nearby Terminal 21 Asok, boasting a mix of local designers and international labels

facts.text: Benjakitti Forest Park, for strolling or cycling, is a few steps from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Just a few steps away from the hotel, enjoy a relaxing stroll or cycling experience at Benjakitti Forest Park.

facts.text: The 8th-floor outdoor saltwater pool overlooks the Bangkok skyline, with an adjacent Pool Bar for sunset cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy an exhilarating swim in our outdoor pool on the 8th floor. Filled with saltwater, it overlooks Bangkok’s spectacular skyline.

facts.text: The pool deck has lounge chairs and spacious cabanas.
facts.excerpt: Escape the city and simply enjoy the view from our poolside lounge chairs or spacious cabanas.

facts.text: Vareena Spa, named for the Thai word for water, has a hydrotherapy room, Vichy shower, aroma steam room and VIP spa suite.
facts.excerpt: Vareena Spa’s seven treatment rooms, hydrotherapy room, Vichy shower, aroma steam room, and VIP spa suite offer a serene design

facts.text: The spa has a wooden floor, lantern-like lighting, nature-inspired patterns and native Thai details such as wooden screens.
facts.excerpt: A wooden floor, lantern-like lighting and cream-colored wall panels printed with nature-inspired green patterns frame plush armchairs and daybeds

facts.text: The WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio is open 24/7 with LifeFitness cardio and strength machines, plus a Run Concierge.
facts.excerpt: Fit a workout into your schedule at our 405-square-meter WestinWORKOUT® Fitness Studio opens 24/7, featuring state-of-the-art LifeFitness® cardio machines, weights and strength machines.

facts.text: Rooms have the Westin Heavenly Bed, Lavender Balm and White Tea bath products.
facts.excerpt: featuring the Heavenly® Bed, Lavender Balm and White Tea bath products

facts.text: Executive Club rooms and suites include Westin Club Lounge access with breakfast, afternoon tea and evening cocktails.
facts.excerpt: including breakfast from 06:30 to 11:00 hrs., afternoon tea from 12:00 to 16:00 hrs., and evening cocktails from 18:00 to 20:00 hrs.

facts.text: Kisso offers refined Japanese dining with menus that evolve with ingredients sourced from Japan.
facts.excerpt: Kisso offers a refined Japanese dining experience in the heart of Bangkok. The menus evolve continuously, reflecting the finest ingredients sourced from the shores of Japan.

facts.text: Zest Bar & Terrace on an upper floor has views of downtown Bangkok and live music.
facts.excerpt: Situated on the hotel's upper floor, it invites you to enjoy captivating views of downtown Bangkok. Unwind with energizing beverages and indulge your senses with live music

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
Suvarnabhumi Airport is 30 km from the hotel.
